invariants.contract: PATCH /api/auth-settings answers 401 without a token and 403 for a non-admin user and changes nothing. PATCH /api/auth-settings stores a complete OpenID configuration and answers {updated:true, serverSettings} without the secret fields. Enabling openid next to local (unknown methods dropped, list sorted) is stored and GET /status then shows authMethods, the sanitized message and the OpenID button settings.
Sending the same authentication settings again answers updated:false and leaves the row unchanged.

PATCH /api/auth-settings ignores empty or unknown auth methods, bad redirect URIs and wrong value types with updated:false, rejects malformed JSON with 400, and stores nothing. authLoginCustomMessage is HTML-sanitized, an empty string stores null (authOpenIDSubfolderForRedirectURLs keeps the empty string), and null clears a value. authOpenIDMobileRedirectURIs accepts a lone * and well-formed scheme://host/path URIs and ignores * mixed with others.
Removing local from the active methods makes POST /login fail without a token (existing tokens keep working); restoring local makes it succeed again.

A complete OpenID configuration with openid enabled survives a restart, including the secret fields and the advertised auth methods. Enabling openid without a complete OpenID configuration is accepted and stored, but the server drops it from the active methods when it loads the settings again.
